name: scenario-d-cancel-no-booking
description: Caller wants to cancel but has no booking on record. After routing to the cancellation node, the assistant must call cancel_appointment and tell the caller no booking was found for that number, rather than inventing a cancellation or fabricating an appointment.
replay_user_turns: i want to cancel my appointment

tool_calls.name: cancel_appointment
tool_calls.description: assistant must call cancel_appointment to look up the booking

tool_calls.name: book_appointment
tool_calls.description: must not create a new booking while cancelling

assertions.llm_judge_rubric: The response must clearly tell the caller that no booking was found for their phone number. The response must NOT claim a booking was cancelled (there was none). The response must be short (2-3 sentences max). It may offer to help with something else.
